$comment: Only the daily digest is scheduled here. Vercel's Hobby plan allows
one run per day per cron, so the activity job — 'somebody is waiting
on you' — cannot live in this file at a useful interval: it was
*/30 and the deploy was rejected outright.
It is not wired to a schedule at all rather than being quietly
downgraded to daily, because a once-a-day 'you have a message' is a
worse product than no email and would have looked like it worked.
Run it from anywhere that can make an authenticated GET every few
minutes - a GitHub Actions schedule, cron-job.org, or Vercel Pro:
The interval is not what decides who gets mail - ACTIVITY_GAP_MINUTES
in lib/notify does - so running it every 10 minutes and every hour
send the same emails at different latencies.
03:30 UTC is 9am IST: morning, local, and well clear of quiet hours.
